title: Kinfire Chronicles: Night's Fall
subtitle: Fast-paced cooperative adventure with dynamic chit-pull combat and radiant kinfire magic
tagline: Light the way, brave the Starless Nights, and protect the world of Atios
loreSummary: You are Seekers, courageous adventurers wielding ancient kinfire lanterns to push back the encroaching Starless Nights. Beyond the protective walls of Din'Lux lies a corrupted wilderness waiting for your party's blades, wits, and luminous magic.
keyFeatures: Dynamic chit-pull turn order and cooperative boost card mechanics
21 interconnected story quest boxes with zero setup overhead
Branching narrative choices and character moral alignments
Rich world exploration moving from Din'Lux into the dark wilds
